question: Which among the following organs in human body, is most affected by Pneumonia disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __Lungs__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pneumonia is a form of acute respiratory infection that affects the lungs.

 
 
• The lungs are made up of small sacs called alveoli, which fill with air when a healthy person breathes.
 
• When a person has pneumonia, the alveoli fill with pus and fluid, making breathing painful and limiting oxygen intake.
